goal: Understanding the basic concepts underlying machine learning. At the same time, using Python, a programming language commonly used in the field of machine learning, for analysis and prediction. Hoping to become individuals who can utilize this technology amid the rapid evolution of generative AI.

guideline.description: Can explain basic algorithms in detail.
For data analysis, able to understand and explain basic Python packages and use them in practice.
For data analysis, able to understand basic Python packages and use them simply.
For data analysis, able to understand basic Python packages.

educational_methods:
**概要:**

          Artificial intelligence is booming, and from the engineers' perspective, machine learning as a means of realizing AI is a popular subject of interest. This lecture will explain the basics necessary for using machine learning as an elective course. At the same time, it aims to analyze and predict real datasets using Python, a programming language commonly used in the field of machine learning. Moreover, with the rapid evolution of generative AI, it aims to cultivate individuals who can effectively utilize this technology.

      **授業の進め方・方法:**

          While explaining the basics of machine learning, deepen understanding through hands-on Python programming exercises using personal computers. This course is for academic credit, and as part of pre-class and post-class learning, reports and online tests will be conducted. This subject is for academic credit, and as part of pre-class and post-class learning, preparation and review should be done.

      **注意点:**

          1. Be able to perform basic computer operations. 
2. Learn the basics of the Python language simultaneously. 
3. Evaluation is primarily based on assignments, but quizzes will be held during class.
